tool.name: add_task
tool.description: Create a new task for the authenticated user. Returns the created task's ID, status, and title.

user_id.description: User ID extracted from JWT token (automatically provided by authentication)

start_date.description: When the task should start (ISO 8601 format, optional)

end_date.description: When the task is due (ISO 8601 format, optional, must be >= start_date)

task_id.description: Unique identifier of the created task

status.description: Task completion status (always 'pending' for newly created tasks)

errors.description: JWT token is missing or invalid
errors.example: Authentication required: Invalid or expired token

errors.description: Input validation failed (e.g., empty title, end_date before start_date)
errors.example: Validation error: end_date must be greater than or equal to start_date
Database error: Unable to create task

examples.description: Create a simple task with only title
Create a task with all fields

input.title: Prepare presentation
input.description: Create slides for quarterly review meeting
